text.content:
A new tower rising where the old one fell.

Region: Corporate Plaza, City Center: the last lot on the outer ring
Controlled by: Arasaka (Accord concession land)
The feel of it: Fenced, floodlit day and night, with cranes and a Shinto shrine at the gate
Danger: SC 10: Arasaka Security, Hardened Heavy. Extraterritorial

The Accord gave Arasaka the deed to the lot where its tower stood until 20 August 2023. The memorial in Memorial Park faces it. Protesters get moved on by the NCPD, who aren't allowed past the fence. Site director Hiro Takemura-Bell reads their signs every morning.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 07
